tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find directories, review sites, list sites, AI directories, launch sites, press and networks that take NSFW AI apps, filtered by kind, kind of app, price, link type, verdict or a text query. Returns name, domain, kind, verdict, price, link, review terms, submit URL and the page to cite.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: The full terms of one place by its slug or domain: verdict, price text, link, review, submit URL, contact, notes and the checked date, plus the terms as a paragraph.

tools.name: where_is_app_listed
tools.description: Which of the tracked places link to a given app domain, from the site's nightly read of every place. Returns the count and up to 10 places with the page where the link was seen. The free tracker on the site gives the full list and watches it nightly.

tools.name: listing_costs
tools.description: Counts and prices across all places: free ways in, paid only, price range and median, link types, by kind, with the date of the last check.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places, get_place · Private data: get_place · Public sink: search_places, get_place.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places, get_place · Private data: get_place · Public sink: search_places, get_place

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
